title: Beautiful and functional
text: Beautiful and functional. Very pretty bag.  The design is larger scale than it seems in the photo. The bag seems strong after several uses and washes well. I air sry it. There is plenty of room inside the bag. I would say it is at least 1.5 times the size of a standard plastic grocery bag. It comes with a zip up carrying pouch that can be used for small things. The bag can also be stored by rolling it up and secured with a set of snapping  ties on the side. There is also an inside pocket near the top of the bag. The handles are long enough to wear the bag on the shoulder with a heavy coat on. The bag is stitched across the bottom, which i was concerned would give out, but so far after a couple months regular use, it is fine.
